title: Personal Student AI Agent — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Coordinates study, research, scheduling, files, and tools from one interface. The Personal Student AI Agent coordinates the student's other tools from one interface. It takes natural requests — 'plan my week', 'quiz me on chapter 5', 'draft that email' — and routes each part to the right tool: the tracker, the quiz generator, the email writer. One conversation runs the whole toolkit, with the student's data shared across tools only as authorized.
